title.narrative: Red Latinoamericana de Mujeres Defensoras de los Derechos Sociales y Ambientales

description.narrative: The Latin American Network of Women Defenders of Social and Environmental Rights influences policies, projects and practices that directly affect women in the region. The Network contributes to the defense of nature and social rights through spaces for debate, exchange, training, denunciation, research and advocacy, as well as national and international meetings. It has the active participation of grassroots organizations from eleven Latin American countries and its strategic lines of work are: Political Advocacy, Communication, Articulations and Alliances, Training and Exchange of Knowledge and Experiences, Internal Strengthening.The grant will support the following priorities and specific activities:1. Strengthening the capacities of the members of the Network through deepening training processes and training exchanges.2. Complementation and continuity of the research process reflected in the situational report (Diagnosis) that highlights the cases of impacts by mining on the lives and bodies of women.3. Expanding exchanges between different organizational processes that we support as a Network to enable the expansion of the network.4. Maintaining the operational coordination of the Network5. Strengthening the Center-South articulation based on the Escuelita in Central America and the conditions that arise from the Ubia power in the countries of the South.6. Enabling the holding of our annual face-to-face assemblies that have been suspended due to the pandemic scenario.
